findings.current: Until about ten years ago, he belonged to the Ironcraft Guild.
findings.defect: The time span is understated: 십여 년 means more than ten years, not approximately ten years.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly places his departure over a decade ago.
findings.replacement: Until more than ten years ago, he belonged to the Ironcraft Guild.

findings.current: Should I round up every servant in the Jin Family of Taiyuan and give them an earful?
findings.defect: The threat's target is reversed. Jin Taekyung threatens to gather the servants and tell them what Hyuk Mujin said, not scold the servants.
findings.rationale: 입 좀 털어 줘 functions here as threatening to repeat or broadcast Hyuk Mujin's disparaging remark to the assembled servants.
findings.replacement: Should I round up every servant in the Jin Family of Taiyuan and tell them what you just said?

findings.current: The way you constantly hounded people to work whenever you had the chance was enough to make even a mother-in-law slap someone across the face with a bundle of kimchi.
findings.defect: The source-specific comic image reverses the participants: the mother-in-law is the person being slapped with kimchi, not the person doing the slapping.
findings.rationale: 시어머니 김치 싸대기를 때리다 depicts administering a kimchi slap to one's mother-in-law; reversing the agent changes the joke's physical action.
findings.replacement: The way you constantly hounded people to work whenever you had the chance was enough to make someone slap their mother-in-law across the face with a bundle of kimchi.

summary: Mostly faithful, with two localized joke-logic defects and one minor quantity loss.
